title: Cascade Robotics Standup - Battery Supplier Follow-up

transcript.speaker: Mei Lin Chao
transcript.text: Update on the battery supplier decision from earlier this week - procurement couldn't expedite, so we're switching to the backup supplier, Voltcore, for this batch.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Whitfield
transcript.text: Confirmed, I placed the order with Voltcore this morning. Their cells are rated for slightly lower peak discharge, so we should retest the high-load motor scenario once samples arrive Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Gustavo Ferreira
transcript.text: I'll run the high-load stress test as soon as samples land.

transcript.speaker: Mei Lin Chao
transcript.text: Good. Gustavo, how did the firmware patch hold up overnight?

transcript.speaker: Gustavo Ferreira
transcript.text: Clean run - eighteen hours on the stress rig with no jerking. I'm confident in the fix.

transcript.speaker: Mei Lin Chao
transcript.text: Great, let's merge that patch into the release branch today.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Whitfield
transcript.text: One thing to flag - with a new cell chemistry, we might need to redo battery pack certification, not just cell-level. I heard back from the certification team.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Whitfield
transcript.text: They said it depends on whether the pack's protection circuit needs retuning for the new discharge curve - they're checking and will get back to us by Monday.

transcript.speaker: Mei Lin Chao
transcript.text: Okay, let's not assume either way until we hear back. Thanks both.

summary_key_points: Switched to backup supplier Voltcore after procurement couldn't expedite the original shipment
The overnight firmware stress test passed cleanly after the race condition fix
The firmware patch will be merged into the release branch
Whether full battery pack recertification is needed is still pending word from the certification team

action_items.task: Run a high-load motor stress test once the Voltcore battery samples arrive Thursday
Merge the firmware race-condition patch into the release branch

decisions: Switch to Voltcore as the backup battery supplier for this batch
open_questions: Will the new battery cell chemistry require full pack recertification, or just cell-level testing?
